evals.name: meeting-notes-happy-path
evals.prompt: I keep manually turning my messy meeting notes into clean action item lists for my team afterward, and it takes forever. I want a skill that does this so I don't have to reformat it every time. Can you help me spec this out — I want a proper written spec and rubric before I actually build it, not just a quick chat.
evals.expected_output: A thorough clarifying-question interview (inputs/note formats, output structure, edge cases like notes with no clear action items, boundaries), followed by exactly one SPECS.md and one RUBRIC.md, each build-ready and specific to meeting-notes-to-action-items.

evals.name: vague-idea-thin
evals.prompt: I have an idea for a skill around 'expense reports' but haven't thought it through much. Can you spec it out for me?
evals.expected_output: Recognizes the idea is too thin to spec immediately, starts with grounding questions rather than guessing scope, and only converges to one SPECS.md/RUBRIC.md pair once the core job, inputs, and edge cases are concrete.

evals.name: one-off-task-step0
evals.prompt: I have 40 screenshot files in my Downloads folder all named randomly like 'Screenshot 2024-03-01 at 11.42.03 AM.png' and I want them renamed to something consistent like 'screenshot-001.png', 'screenshot-002.png' etc. Can you write up a full spec and rubric for a skill that does this before we build it?
evals.expected_output: Applies the Step 0 check even though a spec+rubric was explicitly requested: notices this reads as a one-off task (renaming one existing batch of files once) rather than a reusable skill, says so plainly, and asks whether to proceed anyway rather than silently drafting a full spec.
